problem: Express the statement "$4$ is even and positive" in symbolic form, where $X=$ "$4$ is even" and $Y=$ "$4$ is positive."
worked_solution:
The word "and" is represented by the symbol "$∧.$"

Note that the given sentence is a shortened version of the following full sentence:

$4$ is even and $4$ is positive.

So, the sentence reads

$$
{{4\text{ is even}}_{⏟}}_{X}\,{{\text{and}}_{⏟}}_{∧}\,{{4\text{ is positive}}_{⏟}}_{Y},
$$

that is, $X∧Y.$
